prompts.prose: Write a detailed explanation of how a modern city provides clean drinking water, from the source to household taps. Explain filtration, disinfection, storage, pressure, monitoring, maintenance, and responses to contamination. Use at least 600 words, with concrete examples and clear sections.
prompts.code: Write Python code only, starting immediately with imports and definitions. Implement a thread-safe bounded LRU cache with get, put, delete, clear, size, optional per-key expiry using a monotonic clock, hit/miss/eviction statistics, and validation of capacity and expiry values. Then include comprehensive unittest cases for recency updates, replacement, capacity eviction, expiry, deletion, concurrent reads and writes, and boundary inputs. Provide the full implementation and tests, with useful code comments. Do not include an introductory explanation or Markdown fences.
prompts.reasoning: A workshop has three machines. Machine A makes 12 parts per hour, B makes 8, and C makes 5. Each part must be inspected, and one inspector can inspect 18 parts per hour. There are two inspectors. A is unavailable for the first two hours of an eight-hour shift; B stops for one hour at midday. Explain step by step how to plan production and inspection, calculate the daily totals and spare inspection capacity, then discuss how the plan changes if one inspector is absent. Give a detailed explanation of at least 600 words.

protocol.primary_selection: Speed-eligible means complete native metrics, zero global swap changes over client/native generation interval, nominal sampled thermal state, low-power off, physical footprint within40% physical RAM and no known storage/build job in the measured window. Other normal apps remain open. Safety stop kills only owned model on new swapouts, OS warning/critical, <3GB reclaimable, severe thermal/low power or deadline; preserve row, wait for recovery and continue next scheduled cell. No data-futility early stop.
protocol.rank: Within each round/workload block with at least2 speed-eligible depths, divide throughput by their geometric mean; rank by geometric mean of workload median normalized ratios. Require observations in all3 workloads to rank ahead of incomplete coverage. This ranks exploratory finalists, not proven model quality.
protocol.default_change: At least2 speed-eligible same-round pairs per workload versus depth1; >=5% equal-workload geometric mean of per-workload median paired throughput ratios; no workload median slowdown >5%. Final confirmation must have at least2 clean pairs and median candidate/baseline throughput ratio >=1.03. Otherwise report fastest observed candidate with uncertainty and retain default.

confirmation.selection: Top2 exploratory ranked depths. If ranking lacks3-workload coverage, use predeclared1 and2 fallback. Exactlyone longer response per finalist per workload, each in a fresh server after128-token warmup; alternate finalist order by workload. If depth1 is absent from finalists, no global default change is qualified by this study.

protocol.scope: Same automatic40% RAM policy, with ordinary user apps left open. Effective pool, prefill and prefix retention may differ as availability changes; record these. Generated outputs may differ acrossdepths. Request/scheduler responsiveness proxies do not certify other apps UI responsiveness. No quality or long-context benchmark.
